article.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Leads on First Agentic AI Infrastructure Benchmark
article.description: New AgentPerf results from Artificial Analysis show how accelerated computing systems handle real-world agentic workloads, with NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 running up to 20x more agents per megawatt than NVIDIA Hopper.
article.author: Shruti Koparkar

instagram_caption:
Sino ba namang ayaw ng mas maraming AI agents na tumatakbo nang hindi sumasabog ang bill sa kuryente?

Dito natin matututunan kung paano nag-lead ang NVIDIA Blackwell sa pinakaunang Agentic AI Infrastructure Benchmark, kung saan kaya nitong magpatakbo ng up to 20x more agents per megawatt kumpara sa Hopper.

I-swipe ang slides para makita kung paano magiging mas matipid ang susunod nating AI builds.

#NVIDIA #Blackwell #AgenticAI #ArtificialAnalysis #VibeCodersPH

Source: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-blackwell-agentperf-artificial-analysis/

cover_copy.headline: 20x more agents per megawatt? [tipid] sa kuryente, bugbog sa trabaho.

slides.headline: AgentPerf launches to test agentic AI
slides.body: Artificial Analysis introduced the first industry benchmark for agentic workloads. NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra NVL72 led the initial round, proving that agentic AI requires fundamentally different infrastructure than standard chat.
slides.why: launch of the first agentic AI benchmark

slides.headline: Blackwell runs 20x more agents
slides.body: The NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 platform runs up to 20x more agents per megawatt than the HGX H200 system when executing the DeepSeek V4 Pro mixture-of-experts model.
slides.source_heading: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Runs 20x More Agents per Megawatt

slides.headline: Rack-scale architecture connects 72 GPUs
slides.body: The GB300 NVL72 liquid-cooled rack connects 72 GPUs as a single system. Custom CUDA kernels overlap communication and compute to absorb coordination overhead across mixture-of-experts models.
slides.source_heading: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Runs 20x More Agents per Megawatt
slides.why: hardware architecture and software optimization details

slides.headline: AgentPerf simulates real coding workflows
slides.body: The benchmark evaluates systems using actual coding agent trajectories across more than 12 programming languages, measuring how many concurrent agent sessions run without violating latency thresholds.
slides.source_heading: Artificial Analysis AgentPerf: Built on Real-World Agentic Workloads

slides.headline: Partners deploy Blackwell for production
slides.body: Inference providers like Together AI and DeepInfra serve DeepSeek V4 Pro on Blackwell, powering real-world agentic platforms like Cursor and Pam.ai for coding and sales.
slides.source_heading: NVIDIA Ecosystem Partners Harness Blackwell’s Leading Performance
